successful_hero_request.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create the new flagship GitHub README brand cover for ONEIRLOOM / 织梦师, an open-source visual prompting skill. The supplied images are four actual previous adult fashion-portrait outputs from this project. Image 1 is a beautiful close-up with natural skin, dark loose hair and a black ribbon; image 2 is a rear three-quarter black satin lace-up fashion dress; image 3 is an elegant long black dress seated portrait; image 4 is a rim-lit face. Reuse the woman's visible facial traits, hair, adult appearance, black fashion wardrobe and these distinct photographic moments as the core visual material. Art direction: bold contemporary high-fashion magazine campaign, not conservative Chinese decorative illustration. Landscape 16:9 full-bleed editorial composite, sophisticated editorial photomontage with a visual hierarchy: an enormous crisp beautiful face fills the right 45 percent, smaller seated long-dress figure at center-left and back-view fashion figure partially overlapping behind her. Precisely cut photographic silhouettes and elegant overlapping photographic planes, with lively diagonal composition. Warm authentic skin and black satin against pearl-silver and deep ink-black sections, a small vivid cobalt-blue editorial stroke and tiny electric-lime punctuation. Integrate fine silver luminous threads and a very subtle film-strip rhythm to express weaving images; keep the portraits dominant. Strong graphic design, stunning typography, camera grain, clean high-fashion lighting, natural faces. Exact wordmark "ONEIRLOOM" across upper-left with very large refined condensed editorial letters. Exact Chinese title "织梦师" large in lower-left, sophisticated confident Chinese typography. One tagline exactly "把想象，写成画面。" beneath it. Small readable English line exactly "PORTRAIT · FASHION · LIGHT" in lower margin. Preserve the adult woman and recognizable dress designs; all clothing stays fully opaque and fashion-like. Keep eyes and faces unobstructed by text. Let cropped close-up photograph and full clothing silhouettes contrast dramatically. No gold ribbons, no mountains, no porcelain, no paper-scroll motifs, no ornamental flowers, no icons, no card grid, no mockup, no watermark, no fake statistics. This is a new promotional composite using archived examples as references, not a contact sheet or a technical comparison. Produce an outstanding visually daring fashion-editorial brand poster.

supplemental_request.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset: supporting wide 16:9 editorial illustration for ONEIRLOOM / 织梦师 README, visually matching the first reference brand cover.
